This is an amazing app that turns the board game into an amazing fully co-op dungeon crawl. With Delve and the New campaign using the Nerekhall expansion they have addressed every concern that I had with the initial release. It was fun at release and has only gotten better. Now there is a real reason to own all the expansions. RPG "Feel" of new campaign in Nerekhall is a great addition as well.

Outstanding App that goes along with the board game. Fun solo or with friends. If you have Descent 2nd edition sitting around the house its time to open it up and start playing. The best thing about this is that you get one free campain if you only have the base game but if you have Shadow of Nerekhall expansion there is another campain to play that is also free. There is one paid DLC campain, "The Delve" which I have not played but if it is anything like Fire and Shadows free campains, it would be totally worth it.
Игра-приложение для настольной игры Descent: Journeys in the Dark, суть которой состоит в контроле над монстрами, подземельем и прочими элементами настольной версии.

Descent: Road to Legend es una aplicacion oficial proporcionada por Fantasy flight games. 

Te permite gestionar todo el contenido hasta la fecha de este dungeon crawler. 

CAMPAÑAS

El juego dispone hasta la fecha de 4 campañas con varios modos de dificultudad tomando asi el control del señor supremo y convirtiendolo en IA.

IDIOMA

Todo su contenido se encuentra actualmente en su idioma nativo (Ingles). Por lo que es aconsejable, al menos en este juego, tener bastante vocabulario del mismo para poder entender bien la parte de la historia. En cuestion de tokens, cartas y demas, usa un ingles de nivel basico bastante sencillo para cualquier persona que no maneje mucho el idioma.

¿BUENA ADAPTACION DEL TABLERO A LA MESA?

Sin duda es un complemento mas que añadira horas de juego. Aunque bajo mi punto de vista falta pulir varios aspectos para dejar una app a la altura del mismo juego de tablero.

¡CORRED INSENSATOS!

Si hay algo que detesto de esta clase de aplicaciones. Es los micropagos que debes efectuar para disfrutar al maximo de esta aplicacion. Aunque su contenido es practicamente gratuito. Algunas de las campañas lanzadas por la compañia solo podran ser disfrutadas si las compramos previamente. Punto totalmente negativo por mi parte ya que si hemos descargado esta aplicacion es basicamente por que disfrutamos de su uso en formato fisico. ( ¿Por que pagar otra vez por algo que ya tenemos?

VALORACION FINAL

Sin duda un complemento más para disfrutar del juego de tablero. Actualmente tiene buen soporte y por lo que se comenta, en poco disfrutaremos del "Road tu legend" en español.

6/10

Descent: Road To Legend, is an absolute gem and shining example of the potential technology and board games can create together. With a team of up to 4 players you can play through either the short tutorial campaign, or the expansive Kindred Flame quest, which can be experienced over a session lasting days! with a convenient save feature and Exp/Item Tracker so you can pick up from where you left off anytime!

Each Quest in Descent is a challenging experience which will put your teamwork and strategy to the test with randomly generated enemies and encounters that can keep you on your feet the whole time around, your mettle will be tested but it is a rewarding experience after all the hard work! 

However the games flaws can mainly be player induced, the lack of certain features can lead to some frustrating scenarios. If somehow you may have jumped the gun and mis clicked, the game does not have an undo system of any kind so you will be stuck with any mistakes you have made. so make sure you have somebody aware and not clumsy at the helm of the app! 

Perphaps another minor flaw is that the entire game requires alot of reading, which can pause progress signifcantly and effect game flow, i feel like an option for a narrator would not go amiss! as the Quest Introductions demostrate some pretty decent voice acting! And one which makes me kind of wish the characters were speaking within the game for immersions sake! Though this is more a personal opinion then a game flaw.

Overall: If your a fan of Dungeon Delving, with a level of sadism where you love a challenge Descent is the game for you, though if you have a bad team this game may present alot of frustration for you. it can still be a fun time none the less.
